text:
And the death perderá his dominio.

The muertos desnudos serán a alone dead.

With the man in the viento and the Luna of occidente;

when is descarnen the huesos and desaparezcan the huesos.

Where hubo codos and pies aparecerán estrellas.

And aunque is sumerjan in profundas aguas tendrán that resurgir.

And aunque the amantes is extravíen perdurará the love.

And the death perderá his dominio.


And the death perderá his dominio.

Bajo the remolinos of the sea

aquellos that yazgan largamente not morirán in the tempestad

retorciéndose in the tormento, when cedan the tendones

atados a a rueda not podrán destrozarse;

between his manos the fe is romperá in dos

and the Unicornio of the mal the atravesará.

And hendidos for all partes not is desmembrarán.

And the death perderá his dominio.


And the death perderá his dominio.

Nunca more the gaviotas gritarán in his oídos

or is romperán the olas tumultuosamente in the ribera;

there where is abrió a flor nunca more another flor

ofrecerá his head a the golpes of the lluvia.

And aún locas or muertas as clavos

atravesarán the margaritas with his cabezas of señoras;

irrumpiendo over the Sol until that the Sol is desprenda.

And the death perderá his dominio.

translation.title: And the death perderá his dominio
